digest.component_or_area: plan_review and workflow subsystems (src/rebar/llm/plan_review/ and src/rebar/llm/workflow/)
propositions: Six documentation sites incorrectly enumerate deterministic checks as P1-P9 while the authoritative CANONICAL_DET actually defines P1-P11, creating a stale-reference hazard for maintainers.
reuse.py lines 36-37 cite four line numbers that no longer correspond to their intended targets, requiring correction or generalization to symbol names.
The byte-exact json.dumps rationale in attest.py and pass1.py is pinned by live signed attestations and must remain verbatim to avoid invalidating deployed attestation hashes.
Three new ADRs (additive-only manifest, Burr adoption tripwire, gate-context-never-elided contract) must be authored to relocate load-bearing prose from comments before consolidation.
Untracked follow-up work in production_batch_runner.py lacks ticket citations and must be filed before comment collapsing.
